# GPSmyCity

> > GPSmyCity provides GPS-guided walking tours and detailed guides to historic attractions, religious sites, markets, and landmarks in cities worldwide.

GPSmyCity offers comprehensive travel guides covering cultural landmarks, religious architecture, historic markets, and tourist attractions across global destinations including Dhaka, Damascus, Irkutsk, Caracas, and Mar del Plata. The platform helps travelers discover and navigate to significant sites with detailed descriptions and GPS coordinates.

## Key Topics

- Historic markets and bazaars
- Religious sites and churches
- Mughal-era architecture
- Tourist attractions
- Old Dhaka heritage
- Russian Orthodox cathedrals
- Damascus souqs
- Irkutsk landmarks
- Catholic basilicas
- Shopping destinations
- Cultural heritage sites
- Walking tours
- GPS-guided travel
- Architectural landmarks
- World heritage locations

## Historic Markets & Shopping Districts

- [Chawk Bazar, Dhaka](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/chawk-bazar-44785.html): Historic Mughal-era spice market & shopping area in Old Dhaka
- [Al-Hamidiyah Souq, Damascus](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/al-hamidiyah-souq-36568.html): Largest open-air market in Syria near Umayyad Mosque

## Religious Sites & Cathedrals

- [Epiphany Cathedral (Собор Богоявления Господня), Irkutsk](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/epiphany-cathedral-(sobor-bogoavlenia-gospodna)-40088.html): Russian Orthodox cathedral in historic center of Irkutsk
- [Basílica de Santa Teresa, Caracas](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/basilica-de-santa-teresa-24473.html): Catholic basilica and religious site in Caracas, Venezuela
- [Holy Trinity Church (Свято-Троицкий Храм), Irkutsk](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/holy-trinity-church-(svato-troickij-hram)-40266.html): Orthodox Holy Trinity Church offering worship services in Irkutsk

## Architectural Landmarks

- [Palacio Arabe (Arab Palace), Mar del Plata](https://www.gpsmycity.com/attractions/palacio-arabe-(arab-palace)-49013.html): Neo-Arabic architecture landmark on Cordoba Avenue, Mar del Plata
